what_works: Immersive, uninterrupted scroll through full-bleed case-study photography of materials; the hero is one giant texture-forward image with a tiny restrained wordmark and label-grade type lockup in the corner. Reads as a premium materials supplier, not a marketing site.
what_does_not_translate: The gesture-based cursor transitions and React/Next.js scroll choreography are overkill for a single-page contractor build — keep the composition, drop the JS.
type_observations: Likely a single neutral grotesk (e.g. Suisse / Inter) at small labels + giant pull-line; no display family, scale rhythm carries the hierarchy.
